title: NNUE-class student on existing successor-closed D4 labels: within-root ordering probe
hypothesis: Train a LeafNet-shaped student (features exactly approaches/lifetime-objective/learned-leaf/leaf_features.py applied to the afterstate board, next disc and moves-remaining columns of runs/RUN-20260821T085042Z-c5cf0e71/d4q-labels/d4q-labels.tsv; EmbeddingBag(8902,64,sum)->ReLU->Linear(64,32)->ReLU->Linear(32,1)) on the existing successor-closed exact D4 sibling values (291,890 rows, 8,639 roots, fold column as written by the d4q experiment: its train/validation/held-out origins are reused unchanged). Loss: within-root listwise softmax cross-entropy over the root's legal siblings against softmax(value/T) with T fixed at the root's value spread times 0.18 as in d4-q-clone, plus gap-weighted pairwise margin, plus 0.1 absolute MSE anchor on standardised value. 5 initialisation seeds (0xA52E01-05), 30 epochs, Adam 1e-3, batch 256 roots, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1, CPU or GPU via approaches/lifetime-objective/gpu/activate.sh. Model selection uses validation origins only; the held-out half-folds are read once for the selected seed and reported for all five.

candidate.name: LeafNet h64/m32 listwise student on d4q labels

comparator.name: exact fair D4 ordering (d4q labels); exact D1 0.486 and D2 0.568 top-1 as calibration

data.reuseDisclosure: Reads only runs/RUN-20260821T085042Z-c5cf0e71/d4q-labels (training-role roots from the 0xa52... corpus family, already opened by EX-20260821 afterstate-d4q-stage1, RS-20260821T104500Z-77d21e90). The held-out fold was already read once by that experiment, so this is a diagnostic-tier read; no new seed is opened. A pass licenses only a fresh-manifest confirmation.

metrics.primary: held-out within-root top-1 agreement with exact D4, per half-fold
secondary: inference cost per state of the exported student (informational)
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: half-fold agreement plus seed spread; no interval claimed beyond the d4q gate's own

passCriteria: Selected seed (best validation top-1) held-out top-1 >= 0.60 in each half-fold.
gate.failureAction: Record valid + fail at CHECK (diagnostic): no leaf-affordable NNUE-class student of this size reproduces D4's ordering from these labels; the self-play loop TH-20260821-...-299ed02f stays blocked in its leaf form and its redesign is routed to the larger-student question.
gate.passAction: Record valid + pass (diagnostic, not evidence); register a fresh whole-origin label manifest confirmation (~5 CPU-h of label-d4q) as a successor experiment before any claim that stage 1 of the loop is unblocked.

stopConditions: Stop if the label file's root count or row count differs from 8,639 / 291,890 (wrong artifact).
Stop on any NaN loss; record invalid for that seed.
